abilities.desc_zh:
当形势对他不利时，补天士会在Primes的力量的推动下更加努力地战斗。

被动：

每失去 {{var_13}} 生命值，补天士 Prime 就会获得 +{{var_12}} 攻击评级。对于故事或事件任务的最终 Boss，该值会加倍。

+{{var_14}} 每级
abilities.desc_en:
Arise Rodimus Prime
When the odds are against him, Rodimus Prime is fueled by the power of the Primes to fight even harder.
Passive:
Rodimus Prime gains +{{var_12}} Attack Rating for every {{var_13}} of missing health. This value is doubled against the Final Boss of a Story or Event Mission.
+{{var_14}} per level
